note: Oct 15 (4pm CT NY-close) edition. The market ignored the hot PPI (+1.3%, biggest since Mar 2022): October faded to ~29%, the 10-year collapsed ~27bp off the CPI-day spike to a three-week low, and the dollar fell against every G10 currency except the aussie. The EIA confirmed the -8.6M draw — WTI +2.7% to $96.42, Brent-WTI spread compressed to ~$9.7. Gold reclaimed ~$4,150+; the franc was Thursday's haven (+0.59% vs the yen's +0.34%). Warsh 10:30pm CT is the last Fed voice before Saturday's blackout. FX spots are indicative index quotes.
